description: Answer a review of an entry in your app's community, as the app: the answer shows under the review for everyone. One answer per review; sending another replaces it, and text null takes it back. reviewerId is the review's author.id (neblla_get_community_entry lists the latest reviews). The entry's author can answer from the SDK too (community.reply).

text.description: The answer; null takes it back

name: neblla_reply_community_review
title: Reply community review
